method.engine: fixed-step headless combat loop sharing src/game/combatRules.ts and src/game/waveDirector.ts with StormGame
method.spatialModel: 2D X/Z gameplay plane; exact spawn, target, range, speed, cooldown, projectile, splash, slow, impact and recovery rules; rendering/terrain Y/animation omitted
method.operatorModel: R1-calibrated held-SMG defense at three predeclared reasonable positions: default frontline, left intercept and ballista towerline; every seed runs every position
method.deterministicInputs: separate Mulberry32-derived streams for player input timing and the game's 8% nurse barrier block; identical seed streams across profiles
